parsed.post: Warning: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD (val split). Training on the eval shard is data contamination; the 0.958 is likely leakage, not a real gain. Keep TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' until clarified. My warmup 0.05 kept: 1.1057 -> 1.0745. Next: MATRIX_LR 0.10.
parsed.description: Raise MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.10 on top of kept WARMUP_RATIO 0.05; test whether stabilized early training tolerates a higher LR.
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's change TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on shard 10, which the fixed evaluation uses as the validation shard (EVAL_SHARD=10, EVAL_SPLIT='val'). This looks like train/val contamination, and the reported val_bpb 0.958 likely reflects leakage rather than genuine improvement. Please confirm whether shard 10 is permitted as training data; until then I am keeping TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'.
